Chapter 8: Attempts to Break Free—Searching for Salvation in a Closed World.
As the crises kept piling up, more and more people inside the system started looking for a way out. Staying in that world wasn’t just hard anymore—it felt like a heavy weight pressing down on everyone.
Picture this: one day, an employee meets with an old friend, and they start talking about what it might take to escape. There’s fear in their voices, but also a flicker of hope.
Leaving the organization isn’t just a matter of handing in your badge. It’s an adventure loaded with danger. Many worry they’ll be seen as traitors, or that their former colleagues might come after them.
In one story, someone tried to disappear—to become invisible for a while. But before long, they started getting subtle threats: the system never forgets.
That’s when it hits you—the past clings to you, no matter where you run.
Still, a few actually pull it off. In another case, someone managed to leave the country with help from old friends. It wasn’t simple. He had to change his identity, cut all ties with his past. At first, there was relief. But soon enough, he realized the fear didn’t just evaporate. Instead, he found himself living in constant anxiety, always looking over his shoulder, worried that at any moment, his secret might come out.
And for those who stay, well, they try to find new ways to cope. One day, an employee decides to step back from field work and stick to desk jobs. It’s not a perfect fix, but it gives him a bit of peace. In the evenings, he sits with his family, trying to reclaim a piece of his old life. And slowly, that gap between him and his loved ones begins to close—just a little.
Despite all the challenges, some people actually find a new sense of purpose in security work. There’s a story about someone who chose to use his position to help the innocent, refusing to take part in injustice. That wasn’t an easy choice, but it gave him a sense of dignity—a reminder that he still had a say in who he wanted to be.
So in this closed world, ruled by suspicion and fear, everyone is searching for an exit or a new meaning. Some manage to escape. Others learn to adapt. And a few decide to hold on to their values, no matter the cost.
Here’s the real takeaway: salvation isn’t easy, but for those with courage and determination, it’s possible.
